purpose: Test whether deterministic overlapping local ASR windows recover the same three known human-removable repetitions that are stable in short Phase 2D.6 clips but disappear in 40s context. Diagnostic only; no canonical transcription or product execution behavior is changed here.

success_policy.profile_selection_rule: Evaluate profiles in committed order and select the first profile that recovers all three human cases. Each profile uses a fixed absolute grid from t=0 and independent windows; labels are used only to score windows that the deterministic grid would have produced anyway.
success_policy.note: Passing this spike does not authorize a production transcription change. It only justifies implementation/hardening of deterministic overlap plus deduplication. No semantic detector threshold, join/acoustic/eligibility/promotion guard, execution limit or 5% removed-fraction limit may be relaxed.
